# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.5 Worker 4: Little Ice Age, Silver Price Revolution, 12 Parliament Agendas & 6 Authentic Rebel Demands (oe_cri2_, 0 slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v125_crises.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ==============================================================================
# Rule #14 Wrapper Triggers (Stage plugs oe_rule_is_historic_crises_* here)
# ==============================================================================

# Any scope. Rule #14 = Off (O(1) sleep for both historic crises; Dev override takes precedence).
oe_cri2_rule_is_off = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_cri2_mode_off
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cri2_mode_historic }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cri2_mode_mild }
		}
		AND = {
			oe_rule_is_historic_crises_off = yes
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cri2_mode_historic }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cri2_mode_mild }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Rule #14 = Mild (buffered intensity, higher thresholds, halved relief fees).
oe_cri2_rule_is_mild = {
	NOT = { oe_cri2_rule_is_off = yes }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cri2_mode_historic }
	OR = {
		has_global_variable = oe_cri2_mode_mild
		oe_rule_is_historic_crises_mild = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Rule #14 = Historic (default full intensity).
oe_cri2_rule_is_historic = {
	NOT = { oe_cri2_rule_is_off = yes }
	NOT = { oe_cri2_rule_is_mild = yes }
}

# Cross-Worker Soft Synergy Triggers (W1 Cabinet Actions — 0 hard dependency)

oe_cri2_w1_granary_active = {

}

# Country scope. Soft-check W1 Coinage Anti-Debasement cabinet action active flag.
oe_cri2_w1_coinage_active = {
	has_variable = oe_dip2_coinage_active_flag
}

# Country scope. Real food distress: at least one starving province or negative capital market food balance.
oe_cri2_lia_food_distress = {
	OR = {
		any_province = { is_starving = yes }
		capital ?= {
			market ?= {
				market_monthly_food_balance < 0
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Links to v9.7 Egyptian grain ships (Alexandria or Grain Stabilization).
oe_cri2_lia_egypt_grain_link = {
	OR = {
		owns = location:alexandria
		has_country_modifier = oe_eco_v97_grain_stabilized
		has_country_modifier = oe_eco_v97_alexandria_red_sea_surplus
	}
}

# Country scope. Links to v9.7 Great Yuan / Ming Southern Sea-Transport (Haiyun) grain network.
oe_cri2_lia_haiyun_grain_link = {
	OR = {
		oe_yr2_haiyun_active = yes
		oe_yr2_owns_grain_ports = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Exposed to Eurasian steppe/Manchurian nomadic pressure during severe winter dzud.
oe_cri2_lia_steppe_border = {
	OR = {
		capital ?= {
			OR = {
				region = region:north_china_region
				region = region:ruthenia_region
				region = region:russian_region
				region = region:carpathia_region
				region = region:caucasus_region
				region = region:khorasan_region
				region = region:anatolia_region
				region = region:balkan_region
				region = region:steppes_region
				region = region:manchuria_region
			}
		}
		any_neighbor_country = {
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					region = region:steppes_region
					region = region:mongolia_region
					region = region:manchuria_region
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# 16th-c. Silver Price Revolution Triggers (1540-1660)
# ==============================================================================

# Any scope. A European power controls one of the four historical New World silver mines.
oe_cri2_silver_mine_extracted = {
	OR = {
		location:ccantumarcani = {
			has_owner = yes
			owner = {
				capital ?= { continent = continent:europe }
			}
		}
		location:colquechaca = {
			has_owner = yes
			owner = {
				capital ?= { continent = continent:europe }
			}
		}
		location:tlachco = {
			has_owner = yes
			owner = {
				capital ?= { continent = continent:europe }
			}
		}
		location:guachichil = {
			has_owner = yes
			owner = {
				capital ?= { continent = continent:europe }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Exposed to transcontinental bullion flows via scale, trade, silver mines, bonds, or Chao.
oe_cri2_silver_trade_exposed = {
	num_locations >= 6
	OR = {
		monthly_trade_income > 0
		has_country_modifier = oe_eco_v97_bond_service
		oe_yr2_chao_active = yes
		owns = location:ccantumarcani
		owns = location:colquechaca
		owns = location:tlachco
		owns = location:guachichil
		owns = location:nima
		owns = location:kamo
	}
}

# Country scope. Historic-mode monetary imbalance trigger.
oe_cri2_silver_pressure_historic = {
	OR = {
		inflation >= 0.12
		monthly_minting_inflation > 0.001
		oe_eco_v97_bond_stress = yes
		oe_yr2_chao_strained = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Mild-mode stricter monetary imbalance trigger.
oe_cri2_silver_pressure_mild = {
	OR = {
		inflation >= 0.18
		is_during_bankruptcy = yes
		oe_yr2_chao_crisis_tier = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Eligible for East Asian Single Whip / Great Yuan Chao silver-anchor branch.
oe_cri2_silver_chao_branch_ready = {
	OR = {
		oe_yr2_chao_active = yes
		has_country_modifier = oe_yr2_silver_chao_peg
		tag = CHI
		tag = MNG
	}
}

# Country scope. Already reformed Chao or holds Silver-Chao Peg for rapid Single Whip enactment.
oe_cri2_silver_chao_reformed_ready = {
	OR = {
		has_country_modifier = oe_yr2_silver_chao_peg
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_reform }
			global_var:oe_yc_reform >= 1
		}
		trigger_else = { always = no }
	}
}
